'''Bizal Mavole''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Arcona/Legends|Arcona]] of the [[Bounty Supply Company]] stationed on the [[Vaiken Spacedock]] living during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] and [[Galactic War]].<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Bizal Mavole appears in<ref name="SWTOR" /> [[BioWare]]'s [[2011]] [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online role-playing]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]]<ref name="Release Date/Game Type">{{TORweb|url=info/news/press-release/20111220|text=''Star Wars'': The Old Republic Goes Live Today}}</ref> ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' as the Bounty Supply reputation vendor.<ref name="SWTOR" />
